keyframe_review.note: New keyframe for the whole life, 1680-1825; the state has no Cliopatria row. The page gives no area. The shape is the district of Hildburghausen (a 22 km disc, my radius; the page says the 1868 Meiningen district had boundaries 'very similar to those of the former duchy') with the districts of Königsberg (added 1683) and Sonnefeld (1705) as small discs near Coburg (my coordinates). Unverified: page budget.

region.text: the Hildburghausen share of the Saxe-Gotha division

ledger.note: 24 February 1680: Saxe-Hildburghausen is carved out of Saxe-Gotha. 'the duchy was divided on 24 February 1680 among his seven surviving sons'; infobox 'Partitioned from Saxe-Gotha: 1680'. Heldburg is the first seat. The page names no boundary; the disc is mine.

region.text: the districts of Königsberg and Sonnefeld

ledger.note: 12 November 1826: Königsberg and Sonnefeld go to Coburg and Gotha. 'Saxe-Hildburghausen lost the Districts of Königsberg and Sonnefeld to the new Duchy of Saxe-Coburg and Gotha'; the radii are mine.

region.text: the remaining lands of the duchy

ledger.note: 12 November 1826: the rest of Saxe-Hildburghausen passes to Saxe-Meiningen. The arbitration of the King of Saxony on 12 November 1826 gave 'everything else' to Meiningen; infobox 'Passed to Saxe-Meiningen: 1826'.

12 November 1826: the duchy of Saxe-Hildburghausen ends. The last duke, Frederick, 'became the new duke of Saxe-Altenburg' in 'the extensive rearrangement of the Ernestine duchies' by the King of Saxony; infobox: 'existed from 1680 to 1826'.

certainty.note: A small Ernestine duchy of districts; the page gives district names and dates, no boundaries or area.

sources.title: Saxe-Hildburghausen
sources.note: Partition of 24 February 1680, Königsberg 1683 and Sonnefeld 1705, capitals Heldburg and Hildburghausen, dukes 1680-1826, the 1826 rearrangement (12 November) and the division of the lands.

notes: Written for batch eu-20-l (1 page; budget 1-2): a direct counterpart of saxe-meiningen and saxe-coburg-and-gotha that no Cliopatria row covers (cliopatria_names empty; the lands lie inside Cliopatria's Saxe-Meiningen 1828 shape and, in 1836-1839, its Saxe-Coburg and Gotha shape). NOT SETTLED: area (not on the page); the boundaries (discs are mine: Hildburghausen 10.73E 50.43N, 22 km; Königsberg 10.57E 50.08N and Sonnefeld 11.02E 50.21N, 8 km each, approximate coordinates); from whom Königsberg (1683) and Sonnefeld (1705) were acquired (the page does not say, so no gain events); the Wikidata id (not on the page opened).
